subject.title: feat: add jsonl support to memory indexer

question: Should builtin memorySearch.extraPaths accept arbitrary JSONL logs, or should raw JSONL recall stay in QMD, session-memory export, converter, or plugin workflows?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but accepting arbitrary JSONL is a new memory ingestion capability with sensitive-data and provider-upload implications that current docs and code do not define.

options.title: Define safe builtin JSONL ingestion
options.body: Approve builtin JSONL support only with explicit record and field selection, redaction, line mapping, watcher behavior, memory_get support, docs, and focused tests.

options.title: Document an external workflow
options.body: Keep builtin extra paths Markdown/multimodal-only and document QMD, session-memory export, or a converter/plugin as the supported raw-log path.

options.title: Defer pending plugin API gap
options.body: Keep this open as a design item only if maintainers identify a missing plugin or memory API seam needed before external implementation is safe.

recommendation.title: Define safe builtin JSONL ingestion
recommendation.body: Approve builtin JSONL support only with explicit record and field selection, redaction, line mapping, watcher behavior, memory_get support, docs, and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent issue comment and memory-area history make steipete the best available routing owner for this product/security choice.
